• Quad simultaneous display capable

• 750-watt power supply recommended 
• 285-watt max power consumption 
• 1 x 12VHPWR power input 

SKU: ZT-D40710B-10P | EAN: 4895173626395 | UPC: 810012083423

Inspired by aerodynamic concepts, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 4070 Ti AMP Extreme AIRO utilizes an AIR-Optimized design to bring out the best in the world’s most advanced gaming GPU powered by the NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture. For gamers and enthusiasts who desire the ultimate performance, power to outstanding thermal and noise performance.

• 12GB GDDR6X Graphics Memory 
• AIR Optimzed Design 
• IceStorm 2.0 Advanced Cooling 
• FREEZE Fan Stop, Active Fan Control 
• SPECTRA 2.0 RGB Lighting with 3-pin RGB Header 
• Dual BIOS 
• Metal die-cast RGB LED Backplate 
• ZOTAC GAMING FireStorm Utility 

##### INSIDE THE BOX

• ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 4070 Ti AMP Extreme AIRO 
• GPU Support Stand 
• 3-pin RGB Header Cable 
• 3x 8-pin-to-12VHPWR cable 
• User Manual
